profiles.label: Geographic study window · common-valid mean
profiles.selection: Geographic window selected before radar inspection, using the same paired-valid pixels across all visits. This is not a water/habitat reference; opposing local changes can cancel in the average. Click the map to inspect a local neighborhood.
profiles.interpretation: Mean filtered log-backscatter on a fixed common-valid footprint. dB differences are not ground displacement. No cause or calibrated confidence is inferred.
profiles.cpr_definition: HV_dB - HH_dB on the existing fixed common-valid footprint. Difference of filtered log-powers, not a polarimetric decomposition or ratio of spatial mean powers.

composite.stretch: linear clipped uint8; same fixed limits for every date and case

hint_definitions.hint_low: Low-return candidate: HH <= -17 AND HV <= -24 dB. Consistent with smooth/specular surfaces; dry smooth ground and shadow are alternatives.
hint_definitions.hint_hh: HH-brightening/stable-HV candidate: baseline delta HH >= 3 dB AND abs(delta HV) <= 1 dB. A double-bounce-like candidate, not an identified scattering mechanism.
hint_definitions.hint_hv: HV-rise candidate: baseline delta HV >= 3 dB. Consistent with changed depolarization/vegetation structure, with wetness, geometry and calibration alternatives.

formulas.cpr: HV_dB - HH_dB = 10 log10(HVHV/HHHH), from independently median-filtered log-powers. Sign reversal of the preserved HH-HV ratio; not independent information.
formulas.baseline: quantity(t)-quantity(first loaded visit), on paired-valid endpoint intersection
formulas.successive: quantity(t)-quantity(previous loaded visit), on paired-valid endpoint intersection; unavailable on first visit
formulas.composite: R=HH [-30,0]; G=HV [-40,-5]; B=HH-HV [0,20] dB. Linear clipped uint8 RGB; alpha is paired-valid.

limits: Diagonal-only HH/HV proxies; no off-diagonal covariance, DpRVI or m-chi decomposition.
All hints are illustrative and uncalibrated, may overlap, and have competing physical explanations. No class or cause is identified.
Low-return support is current paired-valid pixels; change hints require paired-valid baseline and current endpoints.
The false-colour RGB channels are not separate physical measurements. Colour is a descriptive composite, not a categorical map.
Fixed stretches can saturate; display saturation counts are recorded. Full COG numerical values are never clipped.
Sensitivity sweeps hold the all-visits common-valid footprint fixed; their area can differ from current-visit-valid areas in the preserved original panel.
Missing values remain unavailable. No coherence, displacement or accuracy is inferred.

provenance.source_policy: Existing NASA–ISRO inputs from NASA Earthdata / ASF DAAC only; no new radar acquisition. Palette software from Matplotlib and Fabio Crameri/cmcrameri with licenses and checksums. No Chinese provider/site used.
